title: Append Host ubuntu block to ~/.ssh/config for key-based SSH to XPS 13 laptop
body: User-requested; new key ~/.ssh/ubuntu_laptop already installed on laptop. Append only, no other lines touched; file stays unmanaged by chezmoi.

cmd: command -v shale >/dev/null && shale intent "Append Host ubuntu block to ~/.ssh/config for key-based SSH to XPS 13 laptop" --body "User-requested; new key ~/.ssh/ubuntu_laptop already installed on laptop. Append only, no other lines touched; file stays unmanaged by chezmoi." || echo "shale not on PATH"

printf '
Host ubuntu
    HostName 192.168.1.169
    User leon
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/ubuntu_laptop
    IdentitiesOnly yes
' >> ~/.ssh/config && tail -7 ~/.ssh/config && echo "--- test:" && ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 ubuntu 'hostname; whoami'
